smallestProposedContract.sourceReference: AreaReference gains nativeRecord?: NativeRecordReference (native formats only). NormalizedFeature.sourceReference keeps its existing name/type plus that optional addition.
smallestProposedContract.NativeRecordReference: { format: 'shapefile_zip'; member: string; position: number; positionKind: 'sequence'; encoding: string; idField: string; readerVersion: 'native-gis-v2' } | { format: 'gpkg'; table: string; position: number; positionKind: 'rowid' | 'integer_primary_key'; positionField: string; encoding: string; idField: string; readerVersion: 'native-gis-v2' }
smallestProposedContract.positionValidation: Shapefile position safe integer >=0, displayed as position+1; GeoPackage position safe integer equal to SQLite rowid or stated integer primary key, displayed unchanged. No rowid/integer primary key means a blocked table with an explanatory sentence. No imported pre-change feature is backfilled.
smallestProposedContract.planAndExcerpt: method?: 'verbatim' | 'decoded_record'; decodedRecord?: NativeRecordReference. No defaults; existing GeoJSON entries omit both. Source hash remains the existing sourceSha256 field, file name comes from the retained source.
smallestProposedContract.excerpt: First line: Decoded field values of record <n> of <member or table> in <file name>; next line states reader encoding; then reader-decoded field: value lines only. No geometry, normalized fields or computed product facts.
